document.title: Individual psychotherapy primary note, encounter HG-E115

quotes: Individual psychotherapy | Encounter HG-E115 | Appointment HG-A115
Clinicians: Mira Patel, LCSW; Nora Ellis, LCSW

observations.statement: Patient continued to put off scheduling the conversation with the supervisor.
observations.quote: Rowan continued to postpone choosing a time for the conversation.

observations.statement: The supervisor's reply reduced some uncertainty but raised worry about being asked for commitments the patient might not meet.
observations.quote: The reply reduced one uncertainty but also brought up worry about being asked for commitments the patient might not be able to meet.

observations.statement: Sleep remained uneven, with trouble settling when work thoughts became repetitive.
observations.quote: Sleep remained uneven, with difficulty settling on nights when work-related thoughts became repetitive.

observations.statement: Patient sent a short message to the supervisor and got a request to discuss next steps.
observations.quote: Rowan described sending a short message to the supervisor and receiving a request to discuss possible next steps.

observations.statement: Patient was able to return to the main request with prompting during role-play.
observations.quote: Rowan was able to return to the main request with prompting.

observations.statement: Patient was attentive and collaborative but hesitant about completing the task outside the office.
observations.quote: The patient remained attentive and collaborative, although hesitant about completing the task outside the office.

observations.statement: No current suicidal ideation was reported.
observations.quote: No current suicidal ideation was reported.
